style: Square mobile app icon, 1:1, the subject centred and filling about 70% of the frame, simple bold silhouette that stays readable at very small sizes, smooth deep blue gradient background (from #1e40af to #0ea5e9), soft studio lighting, subtle shadow under the subject, no extra objects, no text other than the single letter described, no watermark.
